Recomputation rule (reproducible without the script): rows = the comparison file's .rows; dup = rows whose label is duplicate or closed-as-duplicate; nondup = rows whose label is distinct, related or remedy-keep (unlabelled rows excluded); for each approach a in current, library, hybrid: missed[a] = count(dup where partner not in flagged[a]); falseMerges[a] = count(nondup where partner in flagged[a]); filings = distinct .filing over dup + nondup. Each decision table row '| approach | m/M | f/F |' must equal missed[a]/len(dup) and falseMerges[a]/len(nondup). paired-arms-diverge: count rows whose previous.poolSize differs from poolSize or whose previous.top differs from top[].id; at least one must.
